title: Server leak check ignores failures in the exercised operations
summary: Server.tool ignores subprocess exit status; exercise ignores connection, operation and disconnect outcomes and skips absent properties. Startup accepts any nonempty device set after retry exhaustion. A clean Valgrind report can therefore exit 0 without exercising the intended paths. Require expected devices and successful state transitions, positive cycles and guaranteed cleanup on failure. Confirmed from complete source flow; no Valgrind execution or observed clean false-positive report is claimed.
